caption: The drawing depicts a single silver teapot, centrally positioned on a light beige background. The teapot has a rounded, bulbous body with an engraved decorative shield and crest featuring intricate floral motifs and a central script monogram. Its lid is domed, topped with a detailed pineapple-shaped finial. The spout is long, thin, and gently curves upward to the right. The handle, attached to the left side of the teapot, is broad, C-shaped, and rendered in a darker brownish tone, resembling wood. The overall shading and highlights create a metallic appearance for the teapot, emphasizing its reflective surface and three-dimensional form. The drawing is monochromatic with subtle grayscale tones, except for the brown handle. The background is plain and unadorned.
title: Teapot
